chiyya-bar-rav.name: Ḥiyya bar Rav
chiyya-bar-rav.bio: Son of Rav, the founder of the academy at Sura.
chiyya-bar-rav.prompt: A young Babylonian scholar in his 20s with a short dark beard and an eager, questioning look, as if about to ask his teacher to explain; background of the Sura academy with oil lamps and mudbrick walls.

rabbi-eliezer-berabbi-tzadok.name: Rabbi Eliezer son of Rabbi Tzadok
rabbi-eliezer-berabbi-tzadok.bio: Tanna, son of Rabbi Tzadok, who often reports how things were done in Jerusalem in Temple times.
rabbi-eliezer-berabbi-tzadok.prompt: An elderly sage in his 60s with a long white beard and a gentle, remembering expression, as if recalling the city of his youth; background of Jerusalem stone walls and the Temple Mount at dusk.
